subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: What public Telegram album API should OpenClaw support here: group eligible existing `mediaUrls`, add a separate album action or parameter, or defer outbound album support?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-reproducible, but choosing between the existing sequential `mediaUrls` shape and the linked draft's new `send-media-group`/`filePaths` shape is maintainer product/API direction rather than a safe cleanup close or autonomous repair.

options.title: Group eligible mediaUrls
options.body: Port or replace the draft so existing `message.send` media arrays can become Telegram albums when eligible, with explicit fallbacks for non-groupable content.

options.title: Add explicit album action
options.body: Keep sequential `mediaUrls` behavior and add a new album action or parameter, accepting the extra public API and docs surface.

options.title: Defer album support
options.body: Leave current sequential delivery as supported behavior and close or supersede the draft only after maintainers state album grouping is out of scope.

recommendation.title: Group eligible mediaUrls
recommendation.body: Port or replace the draft so existing `message.send` media arrays can become Telegram albums when eligible, with explicit fallbacks for non-groupable content.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already handled prior cleanup review on this issue and is the clearest routing candidate for the product/API-shape decision from the available evidence.
